description: Call this FIRST in any integration session. Returns the project's plan, reputation, key mode (test vs live) plus a fingerprint of the key in use, sending domains with verification status, webhook endpoints, resource counts, and setup hints for what is still missing. Use it to plan the integration before creating anything — and check `apiKey.fingerprint` against the key the app is configured with, so you know you are inspecting the same project.
name: volanea_get_project_status

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

apiKey.description: mode and a `fingerprint` — the key's last 8 chars, to confirm you are on the same project as the app.

counts.description: How many templates, segments, workflows, campaigns, contacts and webhook endpoints exist.

domains.description: Sending domains with verification status. An unverified from-domain is refused at send time.

keyMode.description: Whether this key is test or live, and what that means for delivery.

project.description: projectId, name, publicKey, plan, reputation, disabled.

setupHints.description: What is still missing before this project can send. Empty when ready.

testInbox.description: The safe simulator recipient, and why inventing a real address damages sender reputation.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
